```{r}

# Install required packages if you haven't already:
# install.packages(c("tidyverse", "lubridate"))

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# CONFIGURATION
# ---------------------------------------------------------
zip_folder <- "data/bicycle_volume_speed_2024"         # Folder containing all the .zip files
output_csv <- "data/idiom8_calendar_heatmap.csv" # Output file for Vega-Lite

# Consistency Threshold: 
# A value of 0.95 means a site must have logged data on at least 95% 
# of the total days in the timeline to be included. (This accounts for 
# a few genuine 0-volume days or brief hardware maintenance).
consistency_threshold <- 0.95 

# --- 2. FILE DISCOVERY ---
zip_files <- list.files(zip_folder, pattern = "\\.zip$", full.names = TRUE)

if (length(zip_files) == 0) {
  stop("No .zip files found in the specified directory.")
}

# --- 3. EXTRACTION & PRE-AGGREGATION FUNCTION ---
# This function opens a single zip, reads its CSVs, and aggregates the data instantly
process_zip_batch <- function(zip_path) {
  
  # List all files inside the zip
  zip_contents <- unzip(zip_path, list = TRUE)
  csv_files <- zip_contents$Name[grepl("\\.csv$", zip_contents$Name, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  
  # Process each CSV inside this zip
  map_dfr(csv_files, function(csv_name) {
    
    # Read ONLY the Site ID and Date columns to save memory
    # Suppress warnings/messages for clean console output
    raw_data <- read_csv(
      unz(zip_path, csv_name),
      col_types = cols_only(
        SITE_XN_ROUTE = col_integer(),
        DATE = col_character()
      ),
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )
    
    # Immediately aggregate to total daily volume per site for this specific file
    raw_data %>%
      group_by(SITE_XN_ROUTE, DATE) %>%
      summarise(Volume = n(), .groups = "drop")
  })
}

# --- 4. EXECUTE EXTRACTION ---
cat("Scanning and aggregating zip files. This may take a few minutes...\n")
all_batches <- map_dfr(zip_files, process_zip_batch)

# --- 5. CLEAN DATES & RESOLVE OVERLAPS ---
cat("Cleaning dates and resolving overlaps...\n")

clean_daily_counts <- all_batches %>%
  # Convert DD/MM/YYYY text into formal Date objects
  mutate(DATE_parsed = dmy(DATE)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DATE_parsed)) %>%
  # Because zip files have overlapping dates (e.g., Jan 1st is in two zips),
  # we group by Site and Date, and take the max() volume to ensure we 
  # capture the complete day's count without double-counting identical records.
  group_by(SITE_XN_ROUTE, DATE_parsed) %>%
  summarise(Daily_Volume = max(Volume), .groups = "drop")

# --- 6. FILTER FOR CONSISTENT LOCATIONS ---
cat("Identifying consistently active counter locations...\n")

# Determine the global start and end date of the entire dataset
global_min_date <- min(clean_daily_counts$DATE_parsed)
global_max_date <- max(clean_daily_counts$DATE_parsed)
total_days_in_dataset <- as.numeric(global_max_date - global_min_date) + 1

# Find sites that meet the consistency threshold
consistent_sites <- clean_daily_counts %>%
  group_by(SITE_XN_ROUTE) %>%
  summarise(days_active = n_distinct(DATE_parsed), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(days_active >= (total_days_in_dataset * consistency_threshold)) %>%
  pull(SITE_XN_ROUTE)

cat(sprintf("Found %d consistent sites out of all observed locations.\n", length(consistent_sites)))

# --- 7. FINAL IDIOM 8 AGGREGATION ---
cat("Generating final heatmap dataset...\n")

idiom8_data <- clean_daily_counts %>%
  # Keep only the highly reliable sites
  filter(SITE_XN_ROUTE %in% consistent_sites) %>%
  # Sum the volume across all consistent sites for each individual day
  group_by(DATE_parsed) %>%
  summarise(Total_Network_Volume = sum(Daily_Volume), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Ensure chronological order
  arrange(DATE_parsed) %>%
  # Rename for final CSV output
  rename(Date = DATE_parsed)

# --- 8. EXPORT ---
write_csv(idiom8_data, output_csv)
cat(sprintf("Success! Saved Idiom 8 data to: %s\n", output_csv))

# Print a quick preview to the console
head(idiom8_data)


```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# 1. Define paths
zip_path <- "data/bicycle_volume_speed_2024/Black Rock - Bicycle volume data 2020.zip"
output_csv <- "data/black_rock_daily_volume.csv"

# 2. Extract file names from the zip
zip_contents <- unzip(zip_path, list = TRUE)
# Filter for files that end exactly with ".csv." followed by 8 digits
csv_files <- zip_contents$Name[grepl("\\.csv\\.\\d{8}$", zip_contents$Name, ignore.case = TRUE)]

cat("Found", length(csv_files), "files to process.\n")

# 3. Read and aggregate
daily_volumes <- map_dfr(csv_files, function(file_name) {
  
  # Extract the last 8 characters (the YYYYMMDD date)
  date_str <- str_extract(file_name, "\\d{8}$")
  
  # Read only the first column to save memory, as we just need the row count
  raw_data <- read_csv(
    unz(zip_path, file_name), 
    col_select = 1, 
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  
  tibble(
    Date_String = date_str,
    Volume = nrow(raw_data)
  )
})

# 4. Final Aggregation
network_volume <- daily_volumes %>%
  mutate(Date = ymd(Date_String)) %>%
  # Group by date to aggregate all counters/directions for that specific day
  group_by(Date) %>%
  summarise(Total_Network_Volume = sum(Volume), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Date)

# Export
write_csv(network_volume, output_csv)
cat("Success! Exported to", output_csv, "\n")

```


```{r}
zip_path <- "data/bicycle_volume_speed_2024/Black Rock - Bicycle volume data 2020.zip"
output_csv <- "data/black_rock_daily_volume_fast.csv"

file_list <- unzip(zip_path, list = TRUE)$Name
csv_files <- file_list[grepl("\\.csv\\.\\d{8}$", file_list, ignore.case = TRUE)]

# Pre-allocate empty vectors for speed
volumes <- numeric(length(csv_files))
dates <- character(length(csv_files))

cat("Scanning", length(csv_files), "files...\n")

for(i in seq_along(csv_files)) {
  file_name <- csv_files[i]
  
  # Extract last 8 characters using standard substring
  dates[i] <- substr(file_name, nchar(file_name) - 7, nchar(file_name))
  
  # Open connection, read lines as raw text, and count them
  # Subtract 1 to account for the CSV header row
  con <- unz(zip_path, file_name)
  volumes[i] <- length(readLines(con)) - 1 
}

# Build the dataframe
df <- data.frame(Date_String = dates, Volume = volumes)
df$Date <- as.Date(df$Date_String, format = "%Y%m%d")

# Aggregate using Base R
network_volume <- aggregate(Volume ~ Date, data = df, sum)
names(network_volume)[2] <- "Total_Network_Volume"
network_volume <- network_volume[order(network_volume$Date), ]

write.csv(network_volume, output_csv, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Completed fast extraction to", output_csv, "\n")
```
